abilities.name: garden-abilities/list-posts
abilities.description: Retrieves a paginated list of posts with metadata including title, status, author, dates, excerpt, and comment count. Useful for getting an overview of site content.

abilities.name: garden-abilities/site-health-status
abilities.description: Retrieves the WordPress Site Health status including critical issues, recommended improvements, and passed tests. Enables AI assistants to proactively diagnose site problems and surface security/performance concerns.
